tasks.short: Open accounts only after a signature.

steps.what: List fields still blank for opening accounts
Obtain information required for opening accounts
Process savings plans and purchasing of bonds
Sign the account instruction
File only the signed account instruction
outputs: filed copy of signed account instruction v1

tasks.design: A job lists fields still blank in {BANK}. The teller obtains the information for opening accounts and processes savings plans and the purchasing of bonds. A later job files only the signed instruction. It does not open the account alone, it does not use biometrics, and it does not decide creditworthiness.
tasks.previous_blocker: Forms were retyped into the account record.
tasks.enabler_now: Applicant identifier and requested service are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The teller still gathers the information.
tasks.human_edge: The teller decides the instruction is complete.
tasks.altitude: The teller spends the week with the applicant, not on listing blank fields.

reach.task: Open only the instruction the teller signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a person keeps persuading and the payment release.
Digest [S16] says fingerprint clocking was fined. This design does not use biometrics.
Digest [S17] says worker monitoring and creditworthiness of natural persons are high-risk. This design does not score a customer.

assumptions: Applicant identifier, requested service, and missing field name are stored on the account record. The account record produces them. A blank required field stays blank and the instruction is not filed as complete.
Native configuration of the account record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the teller signed is filed or sent.
Filing the instruction does not approve credit.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining work is still the teller obtaining the information.

incremental.description: Refresh applicant identifier and requested service when the account layout changes, and drop an instruction the teller has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many requested services are blank. The high end assumes applicant identifier and requested service are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List stored items still waiting for the file
Perform typing and filing of clerical papers
Perform microfilm photography of those papers
Sign the clerical note
File the signed clerical note
outputs: filed copy of signed clerical note v1

tasks.design: A job lists stored items in {DOCS} that are still waiting. The teller performs the typing, the filing, and the microfilm photography. A later job files the signed note. The clerical work is unchanged.
tasks.previous_blocker: The waiting list was kept on a cover sheet.
tasks.enabler_now: Document identifier and document type are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Typing and photography stay with the teller.
tasks.human_edge: The teller decides the set is complete.
tasks.altitude: The teller spends the week on the papers, not on listing them.

reach.task: Keep only the note the teller signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a person keeps persuading and the payment release.

assumptions: Document identifier and document type are stored on the filing record. The filing record produces them. A blank type stays blank and is shown as a gap.
Native configuration of the filing record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the teller signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining work is still the teller typing and filing.

incremental.description: Refresh document identifier and document type when the filing layout changes, and drop a note the teller has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many document types are blank. The high end assumes document identifier and document type are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.short: Compute fees from the stored rule.

steps.what: Compute financial fees, interest, and service charges
Check the interest and the service charges
Refuse a charge that does not match the rule
Sign the fee computation
File the signed fee computation
outputs: filed copy of signed fee computation v1

tasks.design: A job in {ERP} computes financial fees, interest, and service charges from the stored rule. The teller checks the figures and refuses a charge that does not match. A later job files the signed computation in {DOCS}. It does not send a collection demand, and it does not apply statutory collection interest unless the stored rule says so.
tasks.previous_blocker: Fees were recomputed on a calculator.
tasks.enabler_now: Fee code, rate, and base amount are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The teller still checks the charge.
tasks.human_edge: The teller accepts or refuses the charge.

ambition.what: Sign the fee exception the day the stored rule and the charge differ.

tasks.altitude: The teller spends the week on the exception, not on the arithmetic.

reach.task: Pay only the charge the teller signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says most of these figures are arithmetic on records, and interest charges are configuration or plain code.
Digest [S12] says statutory interest runs from the due date, otherwise thirty days after the invoice, and the minimum costs are forty euro.

assumptions: Fee code, rate, base amount, and due date are stored on the fee record. The fee record produces them. A blank rate stays blank and is not computed as zero. Statutory collection interest is applied only when the stored rule says so.
Native configuration of the fee record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the teller signed is filed or sent.
Filing the computation does not send a demand.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining check is still the teller checking the interest and the service charges.

incremental.description: Refresh fee code, rate, and base amount when the fee layout changes, and drop a computation the teller has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many rates are blank. The high end assumes fee code, rate, and base amount are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assemble statement figures from the stored rows
Compose and type customer statements
Write correspondence on discrepancies and outstanding unpaid items
Sign the customer statement
Mail only the signed customer statements
outputs: filed copy of signed customer statement v1

tasks.design: A job assembles statement figures in {ERP} from the stored rows. The teller composes and types the customer statements and the correspondence on discrepancies and outstanding unpaid items, and checks that every figure is a stored row. A later job mails only the signed statement in {EMAIL}. It does not draft the words, and a figure with no row is not mailed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Statements were typed from a printout.
tasks.enabler_now: Account identifier and statement amount are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The wording stays with the teller.
tasks.human_edge: The teller decides the statement is fair.
tasks.altitude: The teller spends the week on the wording, not on assembling the figures.

reach.task: Read only the statement the teller signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a draft from the record traces every figure, and a dispute goes to a person.
The executive digest says most of these figures are arithmetic on records, and interest charges are configuration or plain code.

assumptions: Account identifier, statement amount, and row identifier are stored on the statement record. The statement record produces them. A figure with no row is omitted. A blank amount stays blank and is not mailed as zero.
Native configuration of the statement record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the teller signed is filed or sent.
The mail is the signed text and no other text.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining writing is still the teller composing the statements.

incremental.description: Refresh account identifier and statement amount when the statement layout changes, and drop a statement the teller has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many statement amounts are blank. The high end assumes account identifier and statement amount are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The teller spends the week at the window, on the cash, and on the signed amount. A stored total, a fee from a stored rule, and filing that signature can move. The teller still counts the cash, checks the signature, and releases the payment.
reach: A customer receives only the amount the teller signed.
A colleague posts only the deposit the teller signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a payout that the teller has not signed.
Reject a fee that does not match the stored rule.
Reject a balance that treats a blank amount as zero.
role.ambitious_version: A signed payout or statement can go out the same day, and the teller still owns the cash.
